title: Row and column shadows
notes: On another visit, K-1 can play the partner game P6, making a picture the partner cannot change, keeping a dot record before reusing counters. Grades 2-3 can choose a shortest switch route (P6) or more partner puzzle-making (P4). Grades 4-5 can return to the fixed full/empty-column case (P4), set each other the farthest-pair challenge (P5) and then the general two-row distance rule (P6), or finish the concrete shortest route (P3). Save both endpoint pictures; the current counter allowance supports comparison, not preserving a whole catalog in objects. Problem numbers are those of the 6 November 2026 kid-fit packets.
